meta.name: Summer Night
meta.description:
School years should be the best time of our lives, but Lune spends his days invisible, no one taking an interest in him. At the start of a new summer, however, secrets are about to overturn his ordinary life.

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/10 (missing E6-10)

videos.title: Friend
videos.overview: Lune is a loner at his new school. Although he's been there a while, nobody sees him, even the teachers. One day, he captures popular student White's attention when he unexpectedly collides with him in the hallway. White shortly integrates Lune into his VIP friend group.

videos.title: Love
videos.overview: Because of her mother's expectations, Star has to conceal her interests. She goes to great lengths to keep her mother from learning she's auditioned for the basketball team. When she and Lune bond over a love of the band Paradox, the two struggle to get tickets to their next show.

videos.title: Rival
videos.overview: While Star is feeling limited by her injury, White struggles with his decision to confess his feelings to Star. Meanwhile, White's budding friendship with Lune is bringing out feelings of jealousy in Jewel.

videos.title: Past
videos.overview: Conflicted given White's feelings for Star and his own past, Lune tells Star he doesn't feel the same way as her. Afterwards, both Lune and White both struggle to give her space.

videos.title: (Girl)friend
videos.overview: Now that Lune and Star have both acknowledged their feelings for one another and decided to date, Star decides to keep their relationship a secret to protect Ivy's feelings. Lune's easily persuaded, relieved he won't have to break it to White.
